sourceAliases.note: No WooCommerce plugin profile authored yet for an eBay channel plugin; this alias is a forward-pointer. Confidence is low because of the missing internal evidence noted in pitfalls.

preferredWrite.surface: Manual -- no API; merchant connects/creates an eBay shop via the Wix dashboard

pitfalls.summary: No FQDN matching "ebay" was found anywhere in the internal Business Schema registry this session (docs-schema MCP fqdn_lookup), unlike every other channel in this domain (Google, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, and Amazon all resolved to a real internal wix.stores_channels.* service). The mechanism below is sourced from support.wix.com only — treat it as lower confidence than the other entities in this domain until an internal service is located or a live site is checked.

manualSteps.prerequisite: An eBay seller account (an existing eBay shop, or create a new one during setup).

steps.text: Go to Catalog > Sales Channels > eBay in the Wix dashboard and choose to connect an existing eBay shop or create a new one.
Authorize the connection on eBay's side.
Once connected, manage which products are listed on eBay from the eBay tab added to the Wix dashboard.

manualSteps.mechanism: Public docs describe live inventory/listing management from the Wix dashboard once connected, but the underlying sync mechanism (push vs. pull, frequency) was not confirmed against an internal service this session — see the no-internal-fqdn-found-for-ebay pitfall.
